description: Reviews a language or region switcher. Pass `locales` as markup (a <select> with options, or a list of links with hreflang or lang) or as lines such as `de: Deutsch`. Flags flag emoji or flag imagery standing in for languages, options named in English instead of their own language (autonym), options shown only as a code, missing lang on options (WCAG 3.1.2 Language of Parts), invalid BCP 47 tags, labels that differ from the usual autonym in a built-in table of about 30 languages, RTL options without dir, duplicates, unsorted long lists, a select that navigates on change (WCAG 3.2.2 On Input), an unlabelled select (4.1.2), and language mixed with region. Static; it does not load the target pages.

locales.description: Switcher markup, or lines like `de: Deutsch`.

name: review_locale_picker
title: Locale picker review
